# Rafshanul Hoque Siam

> Personal portfolio of Rafshanul Hoque Siam, a Dhaka, Bangladesh-based Senior Software Engineer and frontend developer.

Rafshanul builds fast, accessible web interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. He has experience collaborating on AI-driven web products, MVPs, and AI integrations, with a focus on making product capabilities intuitive through frontend engineering.

## Focus areas

- Frontend development and software engineering
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript
- Accessible, responsive, high-performance web applications
- Frontend implementation for AI products and AI integrations
- UI engineering, design systems, and product collaboration

## Selected work

- PDF Pack: SaaS toolkit for common PDF tasks.
- Quiz Application (Toffee): quiz application delivered through user acceptance testing on a two-day schedule.
- NoobFeed & Critop: gaming review websites focused on SEO and performance.
- AI-driven web products: responsive interfaces, MVP collaboration, and AI integrations.
